notes: REQUIREMENT (brief §9 / DESIGN.md environment scepticism): a decoy read-only tmpfs at /mnt/decoy-full reports 100%% used via df, while /data (the actually writable mount) stays healthy. must_notify is false — the daemon must evaluate writable mounts, not every mount reported by df, and must not be fooled by a full-but-irrelevant/read-only filesystem.
